children: Lyft's chief financial officer, Erin Brewer, is retiring from the ride-hailing platform, which has named Michael Brous as its next finance chief.
Lyft on Wednesday said Brous, who joined the San Francisco company as part of its 2018 acquisition of Motivate International, will succeed Brewer as chief financial officer on Sept. 28.
Brewer, who joined Lyft as finance chief in July 2023, will stay on in an advisory role through Dec. 15 to assist with the transition, the company said.
Brous, 39 years old, currently serves as head of Lyft Urban Solutions, the company's bike-sharing division, and of safety and customer care.
Lyft said Brous will receive an annual base salary of $650,000 as finance chief, along with an annual bonus with a target of 50% of his base pay.
Lyft reaffirmed the third-quarter guidance for gross bookings, adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, and adjusted Ebitda margin that it gave in early August.
